$comment: Global skill routing matrix. Resolves which skill activates from file extension + path + user intent. File-extension routes are evaluated first (highest precedence), then path heuristics, then intent strings. Intent strings are the authoritative source in each skill's 'Trigger keywords' line; this file is the fast-path index.
precedence: 2. path_heuristics (refine when an extension maps to multiple skills)

file_extension_routes.condition: file is project-owned JNI/wrapper code (e.g. *-jni.cpp, *-wrapper.cpp, src/main/cpp/**)
file_extension_routes.enter_phase: Phase 0.5 header compatibility audit before any edit

file_extension_routes.condition: file is under vendor/, third_party/, external/, extern/, or a git submodule
file_extension_routes.directive: READ-ONLY. Run header-compatibility-matrix audit. NEVER edit. Wrap via C-shim if Unsupported.
Configure 3rd-party libs via cache vars / target_compile_definitions. NEVER edit vendor CMake or headers.

file_extension_routes.condition: build-logic/ convention plugin or version catalog
file_extension_routes.directive: Route plugin + dependency versions through build-logic/ and gradle/libs.versions.toml. Never scatter versions.

file_extension_routes.condition: Kotlin source — refine by path_heuristics below

path_heuristics.note: Platform actual; if it loads a .so via System.loadLibrary, also jni-kotlin-pro
iOS actual / cinterop — NOT jni-kotlin-pro (JNI is JVM-only)

intent_routes.$comment: Condensed. Full trigger lists live in each skill's SKILL.md. Listed here only where intent disambiguates a shared extension.
kotlin-multiplatform-audit: what is wrong with this project

hard_boundaries: JNI (JVM, JNIEnv, Java_*) is jni-kotlin-pro. Kotlin/Native cinterop (CPointer, .def) is expect-actual. They are different mechanisms — never conflate.
Any .cpp/.h under vendor/ or a submodule is read-only. Edits are a violation (EP-9). Adapt in *-wrapper.cpp or a C-shim.
Opaque native pointer held as Kotlin Long MUST have a matching dispose()/close() → JNI _free.
